svg.title: Known-best packing of 304 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=304 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete b909e1b rational centre/half-angle certificate in the source's sqcert format, centres in [0, S]^2, read from the retained file at the pin. Finite construction feasibility only; no local minimum, KKT, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=304 known best: side ~ 17.92942776 (certified upper bound)
